balls.text: this is over! The batsman had no clue about this googly.. He played back to it and was hit right in front.
he goes back to pull this to the leg side, gets hurried by the skidder
full and flighted, defended down the pitch
fun and games over now, Rampaul looks to smash it over the infield, but only manages a toe-end.. This lobs for the cover fielder
yes, use those full-tosses please, Rampaul gets a juicy one that is smashed through midwicket
another top edge, this time it's just over mid-off.. It's Smith there.. he back pedals, runs after it, twists.. but still can't make it

Binny catches this one on the second attempt! He bowls this one wide outside off, gives the batsman invitation to go for cut, which he does. But he hits it straight to Binny at point.. it pops out of his hand in the first instance, but as he falls, he manages to hold on to it
another one of those slow offcutters, Rampaul punches it to long on
bowls almost a flighted offspinner, the batsman clubs it to wide long-on for a single
bowls the offcutter, but look at Starc, he chops this beautifully between backward point and short third man.. Only a tiny tiny gap there.. They have gone past the lowest IPL score now
fuller delivery, slower from Bhatia, the batsman though drags it to deep midwicket
bowls length outside off, 107 kph, the batsman defends it to the off side
this is full and outside off, the batsman looks to drive but plays inside the line of that..
bowls the slider this time, the batsman defends it off the back foot
looks to sweep and gets an underedge to fine leg
short ball this time, the batsman pulls but is lucky he hasn't timed this well, it falls just short of Richardson at deep midwicket
he waits on the back foot and pushes this to deep point for a single
this is a beautiful wrong'un.. Tossed up, grips the surface, then turns away to beat the bat
punches this aerially to mid-on for a single

three men converging under this skier!  It lands safely between the three.. Tambe, Southee and Rahane there.. no one calls.. It was a big top edge that landed at deep point.. Where is Smith? Surely he would have taken this
back of length delivery on off, he dabs it to backward point for a single
he throws his bat at this angled delivery, trying to guide it to third-man, misses it.. Much like Yuvraj
slides this across the left-hander, who has a poke, but misses
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot
quicker now, the batsman pushes it to cover
bowls the googly, but this is bowled very very slow, Rampaul waits on the back foot before punching it to deep cover
tossed up and on off, the batsman defends it towards point

this is the end! Now Kohli hits it straight to midwicket. Short and on any other day, this would have disappeared out of the ground, but Kohli seems to have been infected by the same bug that his hit the rest of his mates..Gets hit high on the pad and lobs it straight to the fielder, who takes an easy catch. Da
he is bowling this slow today, the batsman comes forward and defends
floated full and wide outside off, Starc stretches forward and drags it to long on for a single
full and on the boots, again Starc misses his flick, but picks up a leg bye to fine leg
quicker and on the pads, Starc looks to clip it to the leg side but gets hit on the pads
this is a smart shot! No risk in this at all. Just comes forward and chips it over mid-off with ease
short ball from Southee, Starc pulls it down to deep backward square leg
he shuffles across the crease and clips this to deep square leg, but there is just a single there
he is not going to wait, this Kohli.. He charges down the pitch and chips the length delivery over mid-on
floated up on the middle, Kohli keeps strike with a push to long off
full and flighted, this is a classic Kohli shot! Wristy, whacked through extra cover, beats the man at deep cover easily

this is falling apart.. still only 28 on the board! Albie was so patient till now, but it runs out as he tries to launch this slow flighted delivery out of the ground, only manages the toe of the bat and it lobs gently for Steven Smith at mid-off
flighted delivery on off stump, Albie comes forward and smothers the spin
floated on the middle stump, the batsman drives it inside out to deep cover
tossed up and full, Kohli looks to smash it down the ground, but doesn't get any timing.. back to the bowler
this one is chopped too as the batsman looks to push it to cover, but luckily for him, it's towards the slips, not stumps
he is no hurry, lets this one go through to the keeper again
length delivery wide outside off again, this time he lets it go through
length delivery wide outside off, Morkel throws his bat at that one and misses
this one has cut him in half! Kohli moved down the pitch to smash this through cover, but that darted in from the pitch
length delivery on off, the batsman stays in the crease and defends it down the pitch
he flicks this fine off his hips and gets a couple as Tambe fumbles the ball at fine leg
back of length rising delivery, Albie stays in the crease and defends it to point
he comes forward and drives this on the up through cover, but Watson has placed a man in the deep
short of length and Kohli flat bats it down the pitch, Richardson gets a hand and prevents giving away any runs
goes deep in his crease and pushes the back of length delivery in the gap at midwicket
fuller delivery on off, Albie comes forward and punches it to mid-on
teases Kohli with a wide outswinger, the batsman doesn't take the bait
back of length on the pads, the batsman looks to flick, but gets hit on the thigh pad
that's better, he moves forward and drives this past the non-striker .. no stopping that
shout of lbw as this one shapes in. Albie shouldn't have gone back to that one, he is lucky .. as that looked out
now Watson strikes! This is not too different from how AB got out.. He tries to punch this short of length delivery through cover, there is no room, and he ends up chopping this on to the stumps..
short and wide outside off, unlucky to be called a wide actually.. that passed well inside the marker.. No wonder Watson is amused
bowls it full outside off, the batsman pushes it to cover point off the front foot
too straight this time, Rana goes on the back foot and whips this to deep square leg for a single
looks to leave this one, but is late to get his bat out of the way.. He is lucky that this drops down before reaching gully
back of length outside off, Kohli stays on the back foot and steers this to third man
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it down the pitch
now Rana picks up a single to third man, gliding this past the second slip fielder
back of length outside off, the batsman glides this to third man for a single
fires this one on the blockhole, Sachin digs it out somehow
he waits on the back foot and defends the back of length delivery to point
some room outside off, Kohli punches this to deep cover to pick up a single
he has to play the waiting game, defends the back of length delivery down the pitch
another length delivery on off, the batsman stays calm and defends it to off
length delivery outside off, Kohli, who has a big role now, defends this one to point
short of length delivery wide outside off, Kohli keeps strike by steering this one to third man
shortish delivery, Kohli is no Yuvi.. he gets back and whacks it past midwicket, all along the ground
he comes forward and defends the length ball solidly to point
back of length delivery, he edges it through the third slip region.. They had two slips there.. Smith at second slip has his hands on his head
now AB! What's happening! You don't expect such loose shots from AB. Another tame delivery just outside off and AB has a lazy waft at that one, ends up chopping it on to his stumps

he strikes first ball! Yuvraj's year of misery continues..it's only bowled at 130 kph and just short of length outside off.. Yuvraj just hangs his bat at that one and sends the outside edge straight to the second slip fielder. That was a really poor attempt and the ball was not even that fast as he made it look
bowls it straight on the stump, Yuvraj dabs it to mid-off and keeps the strike
play and a miss! the bowler appeals for a caught behind but there is no edge. Yuvraj pushes at the length ball tamely and is beaten
he starts walking down the pitch but is lucky to get an inside edge off the yorker.. That swung into him and went to fine leg. It would have been a half-volley had he stayed in the pitch
bowls it full and wide, Yuvraj watches this one go through to the keeper
beats the bat as Yuvraj pushes at the length delivery inside the line
pushes it full outside off, easily driven to the sweeper at deep cover
leaves the first ball alone as it slides away at an angle

this is two in two! Very poor running from Patel there. Kohli dabbed the full delivery to cover point and called for a single, but Parthiv was slow to respond to a late call. He was well short when the throw from Rahane came to the keeper. More of Kohli's mistake actually, because Patel was responding to his call..

early strike for Binny! Takawale didn't look in any hurry till the last ball, but he decides to show some aggression against the gentle medium pace. He clears his front leg and attempts to launch this over mid-on, but that nice shape on the ball means it kisses the outside edge and ends up with the keeper
fuller this time, the batsman doesn't come out fully, defends it to cover
immediately gets some nice shape outside off, the batsman lets it go through
swings this one into the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep midwicket to open his account
he didn't read that googly at all, he edges it past the lone slip fielder to pick up three runs and register a win.. Not the best way to bring it, but this has been that kind of a match
oh no! Watson tries to repeat the shot but is nowhere near the pitch of the delivery, only manages a big top edge to AB at cover. Chahal continues to impress - he slowed this one down intentionally
reaches out and smashes the flighted one over the cow corner! This was wide outside off and he has dragged it for a 90 m hit
flighted and on the middle and off line, the batsman comes forward and defends
sweeps this from well outside the off but finds the man at deep midwicket
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends
fuller delivery on the stumps, Nayar picks up his seventh run with a flick to fine leg
short of length delivery on off, he defends it off the back foot

he sees the bowler rolls his fingers on this and launches it over extra cover.. Doesn't time it very well. But hello hello.. What has Nayar been doing? He is too late to turn for the third and he has to dive full length to try and get in. He has been saved by a frame.
fires it full at the base of off stump, Watson digs it out to mid-off
too straight this time, Watson clips it to deep midwicket to pick up a quick couple
looks to cut the short of length delivery through off, but finds the man at cover point
stretches forward and defends the fuller delivery to the off side
goes back and punches the back of length delivery to deep cover
slightly short outside off, and because it stays low, the batsman is not able to hit it over the leg side, toe-ends it to mid-on
stretches forward and defends the fuller delivery to the leg side
that's more like him! He takes a step down and hammers the fuller delivery straight over the umpire's head
some spin for Chahal this time, Watson defends it off the back foot
defends the length delivery to mid-off..
looks to pull the shorter bouncer, but goes through with his shot too early, is beaten
beats the outside edge with an angled delivery. That had some extra bounce on it too
looks to push the length ball to the off side, but gets an inside edge to midwicket.. A sloppy throw gives them an extra run
cracks this to point off the front foot, but the fielder manages to get a hand to prevent the boundary
length delivery just outside off, the batsman punches it to mid-on
he bowls a maiden now as he tosses this up outside off, Watson doesn't attempt a shot
bowls the slider, had Watson in a bit of a spot as he was going back and didn't expect it to come in.. Manages to get some bat on it
flatter delivery this time, the batsman goes back and punches this to midwicket
he comes down the pitch and defends this length delivery
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and defends
length delivery on the pads, he dabs it softly to the right of midwicket for a single
he comes forward and defends the length delivery to cover
length delivery on off, the batsman opens the face of the bat to run it down to third man
comes forward and punches the length delivery on the up.. the mid-off is standing wide and he has no chance to cut this off
length delivery outside off, this time he leaves it alone with ease
circumspect cricket here, the batsman has a loose poke at an angled delivery, gets beaten
fuller delivery, Watson comes forward and punches it straight down the ground..
super delivery! Parthiv and first slip go up immediately as the catch is taken by the keeper, but Starc has his hands on the head.. this one zipped past the outside edge.
fuller on the pads, Watson drives it to midwicket off the front foot. Some buzz in the crowd now
what's happening here! Nair slashes at this short and wide one and gets a thick outside edge to the keeper. Easy catch for Parthiv.. Kohli is pumped. Strange sort of period this..
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to midwicket
floats it full and wide, draws the batsman into a loose drive and beats the bat
back of length delivery on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot
he hops on his toes and drops the back of length delivery to cover
short delivery first up, but it's ill-directed, down the leg side

another rising delivery, the batsman gets on top of it and drops it towards backward square leg. He tries to sneak a second one as the fielder is placed deep, but the throw comes in and finds Samson short of the crease.
slightly slower this time from Rampaul, the batsman flicks it fine with ease
back of length delivery, Sanju gets on top of the bounce and dabs it to third man
length delivery on the stumps, defended down the pitch
tucks the short of length delivery behind square to pick up a single
fires this one down the leg side, some interest from behind the stumps as it flicked something on the way.. not the bat though
comes forward and defends this length delivery solidly to off
super delivery! This one is angled across the batsman and deviates just enough to catch the outside edge. Rahane has to go, but he has already done more than 40% of the job
that check punch! He plays it so well.. That raced to the extra cover fielder. Had it been in the gap, that would have raced through
nicely punches it in the gap at midwicket, it was aerial, but right between the fielders
bangs this one short and Rahane sways away from the line
length delivery on the stumps, Karun pushes it softly towards midwicket for a single
back of length on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to square leg for a single
could this be the first wicket! No, this leading edge just evades the point fielder. The batsman closed the face too early
stays low again, hits the toe of the bat as Rahane looks to push it to extra cover
length delivery wide outside off, Rahane lets it go through. It stays a touch low this time
full and on the pads, Karun chips it over midwicket without much timing, but picks up a single nonetheless
back of length on off this time, Rahane hops and drops it towards third man
superb pull shot now! Starch shortens his length and Rahane swivels in quick time to power over midwicket
another one that could have gone for a boundary, but Rahane crashes this straight to Kohli at cover point. Starc is not getting the movement, but he is serving up width
he bowls this closer to off, the batsman defends it off
stylish! He stands up and crunches this off the back foot through the tiny gap at cover point. It was a length delivery with only a little bit of width
another good outswinger, flies past the outside edge as Karun looks to push it to off
he comes forward and pushes the length delivery to the crowded off-side field
he stays on the back foot, drops this one towards points and calls for a quick single
back of length on the body, the batsman dabs it to wide mid-on for a single
looks to punch this wide delivery through off and gets an inside edge, but he is luckier than AB, as this bounces over the stumps
bowls a beautiful first delivery, it seams away after pitching on length and beats the bat
leans back and carves this short of length delivery through backward point, the fielder at third man does well to prevent the boundary
back of length on the stumps this time, Rahane waits and defends it to midwicket
comes forward and drives this to cover
this is beautifully punched through mid-off, almost a test-match shot.. He punches this without any fuss, just a push, and mid-off was well wide
now he overcorrects, this is full and very wide outside off
the idea was right - he bowled it full and got the swing - but the direction was not. It was on the pads and Rahane flicks it fine down the leg side
length delivery outside off, some inward movement but easily left alone by Rahane
